definitions.time: µs of file time from tick 0, no pre-roll; tempo map from every track (SMPTE: tempo ignored)
definitions.notes: note-ons with velocity > 0 on kept channels (channel 10 dropped unless the only one with notes)
definitions.lastNoteOffUs: latest note end; FIFO pairing per (channel, key); unpaired notes end at their track's end; zero-length notes last 30 ms; CC120/CC123 end a channel's open notes
definitions.durationSec: lastNoteOffUs / 1e6, rounded to 1 ms (the catalogue's durationSec)
definitions.cc: controller event counts; has* = any value > 0
definitions.pedalMode: CONTINUOUS if CC64 has >= 8 distinct values strictly between 0 and 127; SWITCH if any CC64; else NONE
definitions.folds: notes outside the compass: grand/upright 21-108, harpsichord 29-89
definitions.flatVelocity: >= 95% of the notes share one velocity
